## Which document?
The file or section with the problem (e.g., README.md > Installation, SETUP.md > Troubleshooting).

## What is wrong or missing?
Describe what is unclear, incorrect or outdated.

## Suggested Improvement
How could it be improved? Proposed wording is welcome.
